item.tib: g.yung drung yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbang chog rgyas pa snang gsal 'phrul gyi me long rgyan 'phreng
item.coloph: ces zhi ba g.yung drung yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbang chog snang gsal 'phrul gyi me long rgyan gyi dpal 'phreng zhes bya ba/ rang lugs kyi dkyil 'khor chen po stong dang drug brgya la nges pa'i snang ba thob pa/ dmu rgyal rnal 'byor nyi ma'i dbang pos brtsams pa dge legs 'phel//
